content: As of Aug 2026: Vite latest is v8.x (v7.0 introduced 'baseline-widely-available' as default browser target); Tailwind CSS v4 setup uses the @tailwindcss/vite plugin (no PostCSS/autoprefixer/tailwind.config.js needed for basic setup) with a single '@import "tailwindcss";' in the main CSS file. TypeScript has moved to v7.0.x (Go-based/native compiler rewrite, ~10x faster than 6.0). React Router v7 (7.9.x) merged with Remix; can be used purely as a client router in 'declarative mode' without adopting full framework/data mode.
